products.name: Obsidian Raw Leather Biker Jacket
products.tagline: Hand-buffed Italian calfskin with gunmetal hardware.
products.taglineBn: হ্যান্ড-বাফড ইতালিয়ান কাফস্কিন ও গানমেটাল হার্ডওয়্যার।
products.description: Crafted from full-grain vegetable-tanned Italian calfskin, the Obsidian Biker Jacket embodies the raw attitude of modern luxury. Features asymmetric heavy-duty silver-tone zip closures, structured shoulder panels, and quilted silk-satin lining for effortless layering and all-season endurance.
products.descriptionBn: প্রিমিয়াম ইতালিয়ান ফুল-গ্রেইন কাফস্কিন লেদারে তৈরি এই অবসিডিয়ান বাইকার জ্যাকেট আভিজাত্য ও আধুনিক স্টাইলের অনন্য নিদর্শন। এর সিল্ক-সাটিন লাইনিং ও সিলভার-টোন জিপার আপনাকে দেবে প্রিমিয়াম অনুভূতি।
products.fabricCare: 100% Full-Grain Calfskin Leather. Lining: 100% Cupro Silk. Professional leather dry clean only.
products.fabricCareBn: ১০০% ফুল-গ্রেইন কাফস্কিন লেদার। লাইনিং: ১০০% কাপরো সিল্ক। শুধুমাত্র লেদার ড্রাই ক্লিন উপযোগী।
products.fitDetails: Tailored slim fit with articulated arms. Model is 6'2" (188cm) wearing size Large.
products.fitDetailsBn: টেইলরড স্লিম ফিট। মডেলের উচ্চতা ৬ ফুট ২ ইঞ্চি (সাইজ Large পরিহিত)।

products.name: Tailored Silk-Blend Tuxedo Blazer
products.tagline: Peak satin lapels for the uncompromising gentleman.
products.taglineBn: অতুলনীয় আভিজাত্যের জন্য পিক সাটিন ল্যাপেলযুক্ত ব্লেজার।
products.description: A masterclass in modern sartorial precision. Cut from an exquisite 280gsm wool-mulberry silk blend, this tuxedo blazer combines sharp architectural shoulders with a softly draped waist. Finished with hand-stitched grosgrain lapels and genuine horn buttons.
products.descriptionBn: আধুনিক টেইলারিং দক্ষতার এক অপূর্ব নিদর্শন। প্রিমিয়াম ভার্জিন উল ও সিল্কের সংমিশ্রণে তৈরি এই টাক্সিডো ব্লেজার যেকোনো বিশেষ অনুষ্ঠানে আপনাকে দেবে বিশেষ মর্যাদা।
products.fabricCare: 85% Virgin Wool, 15% Mulberry Silk. Dry clean only. Warm iron with pressing cloth.
products.fitDetails: Modern architectural cut. Fits true to size with sculpted waist. Model is 6'1" wearing size 40R (M).

products.name: Monochrome Heavyweight Street Hoodie
products.tagline: 520gsm custom looped French terry with metal aglets.
products.taglineBn: ৫২০ জিএসএম কাস্টম লুপড ফ্রেঞ্চ টেরি ও মেটাল অ্যাগলেটস।
products.description: Constructed from custom-developed 520 GSM organic French terry cotton. Boasts a seamless double-layered hood, drop-shoulder drape, kangaroo pocket with hidden card compartment, and tonal high-density matte 'Gentleman Savage' emblem at the chest.
products.descriptionBn: ৫২০ জিএসএম অর্গানিক ফ্রেঞ্চ টেরি কটনে তৈরি এই প্রিমিয়াম হুডি শীতের স্টাইলিং ও সর্বোচ্চ আরামের জন্য নিখুঁত।
products.fabricCare: 100% Organic Heavyweight Cotton. Cold machine wash inside out. Lay flat to dry.
products.fitDetails: Oversized boxy drape. Size down for a standard tailored fit. Model is 6'0" wearing size M.

products.name: Italian Virgin Wool Pleated Trousers
products.tagline: Deep forward double pleats with tailored side adjusters.
products.description: Refined bespoke craftsmanship meets daily versatility. Cut with high-rise waistline, extended waistband tab, double forward pleats, and clean straight drape. Unfinished hem allows custom tailoring to your exact break.
products.fabricCare: 100% Super 130s Italian Wool. Dry clean only.
products.fitDetails: High-rise relaxed taper. Model is 6'2" wearing size 32.

products.name: Vintage Washed Acid Drop Tee
products.tagline: 280gsm heavyweight jersey with distressed mineral wash.
products.description: Individually hand-treated with an artisanal acid wash technique, ensuring no two tees are identical. Thick 1.25-inch ribbed collar, reinforced twin-needle stitching, and dropped shoulders create the quintessential luxury streetwear silhouette.
products.fabricCare: 100% Combed Compact Cotton. Machine wash cold with like colors. Tumble dry low.
products.fitDetails: Relaxed boxy streetwear fit. True to size. Model is 6'1" wearing size L.

products.name: Distressed Raw Selvedge Denim Jeans
products.tagline: 14.5oz Japanese shuttle-loom denim with custom fading.
products.description: Woven in Kurashiki, Japan on vintage shuttle looms. These 14.5oz red-line selvedge jeans undergo a 4-stage hand-distressing process for authentic wear marks. Features custom gunmetal donut buttons and heavy leather patch.
products.fabricCare: 100% Japanese Cotton Denim. Wash cold inside out sparingly to preserve raw patina.
products.fitDetails: Slim straight leg with a slight taper below the knee. Model is 6'2" wearing size 32x32.

products.name: Pure Cashmere Mock-Neck Knit Sweater
products.tagline: Grade-A Mongolian cashmere with ribbed architectural trims.
products.description: Unrivaled thermal softness and featherlight weight. Sourced sustainably from Mongolian mountain goats, this 2-ply 12-gauge knit offers supreme insulation with a modern structured mock collar that slides gracefully under outerwear or blazers.
products.fabricCare: 100% Grade-A Cashmere. Hand wash with wool detergent or gentle dry clean. Do not wring.
products.fitDetails: Tailored contemporary fit. Model is 6'1" wearing size L.

products.name: Luxury Pima Cotton Crisp Dress Shirt
products.tagline: 120s two-ply Peruvian Pima with mother-of-pearl buttons.
products.description: Engineered for the discerning professional. High-density weave offers wrinkle resistance while retaining silky breathability. Features a spread collar designed to frame tie knots perfectly, removable brass collar stays, and curved hem.
products.fabricCare: 100% Peruvian Pima Cotton. Warm machine wash. Warm iron while slightly damp.
products.fitDetails: Slim tailored fit with back darts. Model is 6'2" wearing size 16 (L).

products.name: French Terry Oversized Street Hoodie
products.tagline: Minimalist silhouette with hidden side stash pockets.
products.description: A luxury everyday essential. Custom-dyed with raw pigment dye wash, seamless side construction, dropped armholes, and minimalist matte branded plate at the hood apex.
products.fabricCare: 100% Ring-Spun Cotton (480 GSM). Machine wash cold. Air dry.
products.fitDetails: Relaxed drape with cropped hemline. Model is 6'0" wearing size M.

products.name: Silk-Touch Resort Camp Collar Shirt
products.tagline: Airy tencel-silk drape with custom abstract botanical motifs.
products.description: Channel effortless Mediterranean luxury. Silky smooth touch with relaxed Cuban collar, mother-of-pearl buttons, and straight boxy hem tailored for warm summer evenings and tropical getaways.
products.fabricCare: 70% Tencel Modal, 30% Mulberry Silk. Cold hand wash or dry clean.
products.fitDetails: Relaxed breezy fit. True to size. Model is 6'1" wearing size L.

products.name: Double-Breasted Cashmere Blend Overcoat
products.tagline: Full-length bespoke silhouette in 680gsm heavy melton.
products.description: The quintessential gentleman power piece. Woven from 75% virgin wool and 25% cashmere for heavyweight drape and structural warmth. Features wide peak lapels, horn buttons, deep internal welt pockets, and a dramatic back vent.
products.fabricCare: 75% Wool, 25% Cashmere. Specialty dry clean only. Store on wide wooden hanger.
products.fitDetails: Structured tailored fit with room for layering over suits. Model is 6'2" wearing size 42R.

products.name: Tactical Minimalist Cargo Trousers
products.tagline: Water-repellent technical ripstop with magnetic closure pockets.
products.description: Bridging utilitarian capability with sleek minimalist geometry. Cut from Japanese high-density matte ripstop fabric with subtle stretch. Concealed Fidlock-style magnetic bellows pockets and adjustable bungee ankle cuffs.
products.fabricCare: 92% Tech Polyamide, 8% Elastane. Machine wash cold. Do not tumble dry.
products.fitDetails: Tapered technical silhouette with articulated knee darts. Model is 6'1" wearing size 32.

products.name: Handmade Full-Grain Leather Chelsea Boots
products.tagline: Goodyear-welted Spanish calfskin with Dainite rubber sole.
products.description: Constructed by master shoemakers in Almansa, Spain. Features a whole-cut vamp from hand-selected French box calf leather, flexible elastic gore panels, and Goodyear welt construction for lifetime resoling.
products.fabricCare: French Box Calfskin. Clean with saphir cream polish and horsehair brush.
products.fitDetails: Fits true to dress shoe size (half size down from athletic sneakers). Model wears EU 43 (US 10).

products.name: Luxury Weekender Duffel in Vegetable Leather
products.tagline: Full-grain saddle leather with solid brass hardware.
products.description: The ultimate companion for high-altitude travel and spontaneous weekend escapes. Features an reinforced bottom with protective brass feet, dedicated padded 16" laptop chamber, and a detachable padded shoulder strap.
products.fabricCare: Vegetable-Tanned Saddle Leather. Conditioning balm every 6 months.
products.fitDetails: Airline carry-on approved dimensions: 52cm x 28cm x 26cm (42L volume).

products.name: Savage 18K Gold & Onyx Signet Ring
products.tagline: Solid 925 sterling silver plated in 5-micron 18K yellow gold.
products.description: Featuring a natural hand-carved black onyx cabochon set in a geometrically chiseled signet frame. Micro-engraved with the signature Gentleman Savage crossed swords crest along the inner band.
products.fabricCare: 18K Gold Vermeil over 925 Silver, Natural Black Onyx. Polish with micro-suede cloth.
products.fitDetails: Standard US ring sizing. Medium-weight feel on the finger (14.2g).

products.name: Suede Minimalist Bomber Jacket
products.tagline: Buttery soft goat suede with tone-on-tone wool ribbed cuffs.
products.description: A refined take on the iconic flight jacket. Tailored from ultra-plush velvet goat suede with a double-ended antique silver zip, discreet seam pockets, and a satin interior with dual chest pockets.
products.fabricCare: 100% Premium Goat Suede. Specialist suede clean only.
products.fitDetails: Streamlined tailored bomber fit. Model is 6'1" wearing size L.

reviews.title: Unbelievable craftsmanship and leather quality
reviews.comment: The calfskin has incredible weight and smell. The hardware feels indestructible. Easily on par with luxury fashion houses selling at triple the price. True to size.

reviews.title: Showstopper jacket
reviews.comment: Wore this to Milan Fashion Week and received compliments all night. The tailored silhouette gives a sharp look while still feeling rebellious.

reviews.title: Masterpiece in tailoring
reviews.comment: The lapels and waist contouring are immaculate. The silk sheen catches ambient lighting with subtle sophistication.

reviews.title: The heaviest and cleanest hoodie I own
reviews.comment: The 520gsm terry is thick, warm, and the hood stands up cleanly on its own. Absolute perfection.
